queries.query: SELECT id,status,version_no,master_id,controlled_time,effective_date,activated_time,obsoleted_time,distributed_time FROM dcc_controlled_file WHERE tenant_id=1 AND id IN (2054545668044084026,2054545668044084032,2054545668044084033) ORDER BY id;

SELECT id,current_active_controlled_file_id,latest_controlled_file_id,status FROM dcc_controlled_file_master WHERE tenant_id=1 AND id IN (SELECT master_id FROM dcc_controlled_file WHERE tenant_id=1 AND id IN (2054545668044084026,2054545668044084033));

SELECT id,native_version_id,canonical_status,domain_status,active_unique_flag,open_candidate_unique_flag,last_transition_time FROM controlled_content_version_ref WHERE tenant_id=1 AND native_version_id IN (2054545668044084026,2054545668044084032,2054545668044084033) ORDER BY id;
SELECT id,job_id,handler_name,begin_time,end_time,status,result FROM infra_job_log WHERE job_id=5625 AND deleted=0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 2;
